content: Erik ten Hag is reportedly on the brink of being sacked by Bayer Leverkusen after a difficult start to the Bundesliga season, collecting just one point from two games. The former Manchester United boss faces internal criticism, with the club considering a change in leadership.

content: Liverpool has submitted a £35 million bid for Crystal Palace defender Marc Guehi, but Palace is holding out for £40 million. Guehi is keen on the move, and negotiations continue as Liverpool looks to strengthen their defensive options before the transfer window closes.
